descriptionChirho: To designate or appoint someone to a particular role or function; used of Jesus being appointed as judge of the living and the dead (Acts 10:42)

To set boundaries, fix times, or foreordain events according to divine counsel; used of God's predetermined plan (Luke 22:22, Acts 2:23), human decisions (Acts 11:29), appointed times and boundaries (Acts 17:26, 17:31), and fixing a particular day (Heb 4:7)
To publicly mark out or designate with a declaration; used in Romans 1:4 of Jesus being declared Son of God with power by the resurrection from the dead
